_comment: The Windows scoreboard. Every `skip:` in a test file is listed here, by file and reason; scripts/invariants.test.mjs fails the build on an unlisted gate and on a stale entry, so a new gate cannot be added silently and a removed one cannot linger. kind: 'asymmetry' is a real, agreed platform difference and must name a counterpart test asserting the other side; 'capability' skips only on a machine lacking a tool (it runs on every CI leg); 'temporary' is a gate that will be removed and must name the PR that removes it. The 19 harness-bug gates that once made up most of the Windows skip list (POSIX-only stub binaries, ':'-joined PATHs, POSIX path literals) are gone: converted to packages/test-support. exec.win.test.ts's inverted gate is listed and counted so nobody mistakes it for coverage that runs locally.

gates.counterpart: spawn.test.ts: 'abort on Windows settles at once and terminates the child — there is no signal disposition to honour'

gates.counterpart: spawn.test.ts: 'abort settles at once with the sentinel exit code and still signals the child' (the POSIX half)
